name: plan-furnish-mobile
description: PLAN-FURNISH Phase 2 ladder (mobile/touch): the 2D-plan 'Furnish' entry is hidden on mobile in Simple mode, shown in Pro; mobile TAP-TO-PLACE (tap a catalog card to arm, tap the plan to commit — the same onDown branch as desktop, since a touch pointerdown reports button:0); mobile LONG-PRESS-FROM-CARD (simulated: arm + hide catalog like CatalogCard's real long-press timer does, then drive the ghost/commit purely via window-level touch PointerEvents — the code path FloorPlanEditor's own long-press effect uses, since that gesture's real touchmove/touchend are captured to the catalog card, never to the plan <svg>); an off-plan lift cancels instead of committing; stamp-mode reuse skips the confirm bar and stays armed for repeat drops; every placement round-trips into the 3D scene. Run at 390x844 with SHOT_TOUCH=1.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: find-valid-drop-spot-tap
steps.eval: (async function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg.plan-paper'); const shapes = [...svg.querySelectorAll('[stroke-dasharray="4 3"]')]; const rects = shapes.map(s => s.getBoundingClientRect()).filter(r => r.width > 40 && r.height > 40); rects.sort((a, b) => b.width * b.height - a.width * a.height); const frame = () => new Promise((res) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(res))); const offsets = [[0.5,0.5],[0.25,0.25],[0.75,0.25],[0.25,0.75],[0.75,0.75],[0.5,0.25],[0.5,0.75],[0.25,0.5],[0.75,0.5]]; for (const r of rects) { for (const [fx, fy] of offsets) { const x = r.left + r.width * fx; const y = r.top + r.height * fy; svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'touch' })); await frame(); const g = document.querySelector('[data-plan-ghost="sofa-3seat"]'); if (g && g.getAttribute('data-plan-ghost-valid') === 'true') { window.__pt = { x, y }; return; } } } throw new Error('No valid drop spot found for the tap leg'); })()

steps.name: tap-plan-to-commit

steps.name: drag-ghost-via-window-touch-events
steps.eval: (async function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg.plan-paper'); const shapes = [...svg.querySelectorAll('[stroke-dasharray="4 3"]')]; const rects = shapes.map(s => s.getBoundingClientRect()).filter(r => r.width > 40 && r.height > 40); rects.sort((a, b) => b.width * b.height - a.width * a.height); const frame = () => new Promise((res) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(res))); const offsets = [[0.5,0.5],[0.25,0.25],[0.75,0.25],[0.25,0.75],[0.75,0.75],[0.5,0.25],[0.5,0.75],[0.25,0.5],[0.75,0.5]]; for (const r of rects) { for (const [fx, fy] of offsets) { const x = r.left + r.width * fx; const y = r.top + r.height * fy; window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 7, pointerType: 'touch' })); await frame(); const g = document.querySelector('[data-plan-ghost="sofa-3seat"]'); if (g && g.getAttribute('data-plan-ghost-valid') === 'true') { window.__pt = { x, y }; return; } } } throw new Error('No valid drop spot found for the long-press-drag leg — the window pointermove effect may not be tracking the ghost'); })()
